categories.name: Meal Types & Value Combos
categories.description: Choose your format: Bowls, Plates, Bigger Plates, Bundles, and Family Meals. Mix and match any side and wok-seared entrees.

items.name: Bowl
items.description: 1 Side + 1 Entrée. A fast, portion-controlled solo meal with generous volume.

items.name: Plate
items.description: 1 Side + 2 Entrées. The guest favorite offering the perfect balance of flavor variety.

items.name: Bigger Plate
items.description: 1 Side + 3 Entrées. The lowest cost per entrée. Ideal for serious appetites.

items.name: Panda Bundles
items.description: Your choice of Bowl, Plate, or Bigger Plate bundled with a 22oz fountain drink at a combo discount.

items.name: Panda Cub Meal™
items.description: Kids' meal featuring 1 Junior Entrée, 1 Junior Side, fruit snack, and choice of water or organic juice.

items.name: 5-Person Family Meal
items.description: 3 Large Entrées + 2 Large Sides. Saves $30–$40 compared to individual plates for groups.

items.name: String Bean Chicken Breast

items.name: Wok-Glazed Wagyu Dumplings (Premium)
